relationships.subject: LH GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: repeated activation of the LH<sup>GABA</sup>→VTA projection was sufficient to increase the expression of mesolimbic BDNF protein

relationships.subject: LH GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Trans-synaptic viral tracing revealed a monosynaptic connection between LH GABAergic neurons and VTA GABAergic neurons.

relationships.subject: ANA-12
relationships.evidence_quote: the pain behaviors induced by activation of the LH<sup>GABA</sup>→VTA projection could be prevented by pretreatment with intra-NAc administration of ANA-12, a TrkB receptor antagonist

key_findings: Activation of the LH GABA to VTA projection inhibits VTA GABAergic interneurons, disinhibiting DA neurons, increasing NAc dopamine release and mesolimbic BDNF, and promoting pain; inhibition was analgesic in CCI and CFA mice.
Pain induced by LH GABA to VTA activation was prevented by intra-NAc TrkB antagonist ANA-12.
